Title: Dead Drop
Descriptions: You look like you can still walk a straight line. Good enough. Insight Cell is trying to keep a few relays alive while the rest of Chernarus eats itself. Take this sealed note to Tomas Kovic on the hunting pad across the yard — do not open it. If he is still breathing, he will know what to do.
The note is not a souvenir. Find Tomas at the hunting pad and hand it over.
You did the simple thing correctly. That is rarer than you think.
ObjectiveText: Deliver the sealed note to Tomas Kovic at the hunting pad.
